title: Core evidence on WBCAtt and Acevedo
label: tab:exp40-core-evidence
caption: Main results on WBCAtt and Acevedo.
description: This table compares Ours with six baseline and reference systems on WBCAtt attribute and statement metrics, Acevedo weighted F1, and intervention-dependency response. Its purpose is to provide the main quantitative evidence for assessing predictive performance, statement behavior, and decision response under the shared three-seed protocol.
context_notes: Values are reported mean ± sample standard deviation over seeds 17, 29, and 43.
N/A denotes an unsupported method-output contract, not zero.
Best and second-best available results are bolded and underlined; the proposed method is shaded.
C1 is mixed; C3 has directional support but remains mixed because registered margins and harm balance are unfavorable.
Dependency measures decision response and must not be interpreted as medical localization evidence.
